home.tagline: Book a real office. See how it could fit you.
home.sub: Every office below is a real listing with real photos. Pick one, see AI fit concepts from its own room, then book by chat.
home.decorative: Decorative illustration — not a real listing
home.realNote: Photos on these cards come from each listing itself. Anything illustrated on this page is decoration only.
home.step1Body: A short phone video is enough. We pull keyframes, estimate specs, and write the listing in Arabic and English.
home.step2Body: First the room as it is today, then AI fit concepts — startup, clinic, training — rendered from that same room.
home.step3Body: Ask in Egyptian Arabic, pick a day, add cafe coffee, and pay. No forms marathon.
home.fitTitle: Bare room in, fitted office out
home.fitBody: Semifinished spaces rent for less because you finish them. Our fit concepts show what the exact room could hold before you commit — they are concepts, not the current state.
upload.title: List your office
upload.videoHint: Pick a short walkthrough video (max 100 MB). Frames are extracted in your browser.
upload.failed: Something went wrong, please try again
edit.title: Review & edit specs
edit.note: Any edit you make is marked as owner-edited.
viewer.fitNote: Fit renders are AI concepts from the real room — not the current state.
booking.name: Name
booking.longTermNote: Bare/semifinished: you do the final fit-out, lower rent. See the fit concepts above, then chat to arrange.
chat.title: Chat to book
chat.subtitle: Talk in Egyptian Arabic as usual. The agent can add cafe coffee to your booking.
chat.greeting: Welcome to Offisio. What kind of office are you looking for, where, and for when?
chat.placeholder: Type here… e.g. I want an office tomorrow in Cairo, add a cappuccino
bookingPage.title: Your booking
bookingPage.note: Your booking is confirmed only after Paymob sends the payment confirmation. Returning from the payment page alone is not a confirmation.
bookingCard.cafeNotConfigured: Cafe line not configured (set CAFE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER) or no cafe items.
